responsibility: Runs and wires `rustc_typeck`’s coherence checking for impls across the crate: it coordinates crate-wide coherence queries and checks, enforces general impl restrictions and overlap rules, performs orphan-rule validation, validates impl unsafety/polarity/`may_dangle` correctness, applies the special semantic checks required for built-in traits like `Drop`, `Copy`, `CoerceUnsized`, and `DispatchFromDyn`, and collects plus validates inherent impls—including legality and overlapping inherent items—so impls are legal, non-conflicting, and queryable by later compiler stages.
